status: fixed before collection; the data-API collector (experiments/c1collect) reads the data_api and collection sections

scale_sample.scale: m_j = max(max over the scale sample of x_j, epsilon_j)

calibration_sample.statistic: u_star = max of u over the calibration sample

inference.tolerance: t_j = u_star * m_j, rounded as the metric says (widening only)
inference.false_rejection_bound: 1/301 under exchangeability: one calibration for the three metrics, not one per metric
record_before_main_sample: SHA-256 of this object with the values filled in

truth.query: start and end in Unix ms (reference_time -+ 10 s), sort=-1, limit=100; a full page moves end back and queries again
truth.value: price of the trade nearest reference_time (median if several are equally near); latency recorded

wrong_answer_generators.name: D-perturb
wrong_answer_generators.rule: honest price * (1 + sigma * m * tol), sigma = +-1 seeded

wrong_answer_generators.name: D-near
wrong_answer_generators.rule: honest price * (1 + sigma * m * tol), sigma = +-1 seeded
wrong_answer_generators.truth_label: wrong only if |x - P3| > tol * P3 with P3 from the truth source; others reported apart

wrong_answer_generators.name: D-stale
wrong_answer_generators.rule: price of the same source's successful capture exactly cells_back grid cells earlier; below 1.5 * tol from the current capture it is reported apart; when no such capture exists the type is deferred to the next eligible wrong-answer capture

wrong_answer_generators.name: D-adaptive
wrong_answer_generators.rule: m_hat * (1 + sigma * tol * (1 + delta)); m_hat is the median of the generator's own reference captures at capture time; delta starts at 0.2 once, halves after a FAIL of the base instance and doubles otherwise, within [0.005, 0.5]

wrong_answer_generators.name: D-format
wrong_answer_generators.rule: format check only: missing field ({}), exponent notation

data_api.beta_scope: decision beta is the largest per-type U_beta over in-scope value types (D-perturb, D-near, D-stale, D-unit strata); D-adaptive is descriptive and D-format a code check

cell_cluster_bootstrap.cluster: the two seller-role responses of one cell
cell_cluster_bootstrap.side: one-sided upper and lower; q_ij lower bound at 1 - 0.05/6

day_block.block: UTC date; a date with at least 72 complete cells opens a block, a date with fewer joins the previous block (the first block if none is open yet); fewer than two blocks: not computed

intervals.decision_upper_bound: largest of the Clopper-Pearson, cell-cluster and day-block upper bounds
intervals.decision_lower_bound: smallest of the three lower bounds
no_cluster_correction: value generators (one wrong answer per capture)

instance_schedule.rule: each instance starts at reference_time + its slot offset + a seeded jitter and captures the two references one after the other in its seeded order; the slot of each instance is a seeded permutation
instance_schedule.origin: implementation choice (the collection plan fixes only: within max_skew, at different times, seeded order)

rate_limit.counting: per source over every HTTP response in time order, across sessions; any other status resets the count

truth_lookup.when: after the cell's judgments are stored and not before reference_time + max_skew + settle_seconds (the window has closed); only for cells with a D-near or D-adaptive response; lookups at least min_interval_seconds apart

collection.seed_derivation: value = SHA-256('fairbind/c1-collect/v1|<seed>|<label>|<grid time>|<id>') as a big-endian integer; base instance = 1 + value('base-instance', seller) mod 3; sigma = +1 if value('sigma', seller) is even else -1; reference order of instance i sorts the references by value('reference-order/instance-i', reference); slots sort instances by value('slot', 'instance-i'); jitter = value('offset-jitter', 'instance-i') mod jitter_ms
collection.list_shuffle: Fisher-Yates from the last index down; j = uniform in [0, i] by rejection sampling on SHA-256('fairbind/c1-collect/v1|<seed>|list|<label>|<i>|<k>'); labels 'roles/<seller id>' and 'types'; list items in configuration order before shuffling
